senses.gloss: f. (בצע, cmp. בִּצָּה) ditch, dike, pond.—Pl. בִּצְעִים, בִּצְעִין, בִּי׳.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 3:4">Tosef. Snh. III, 4</cite> <he>שתי בצעין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>ביצועין</he>); <cite ref="Shevuot 16a:6">Shebu. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>שני בצעים וכ׳</he> Ar. (read <cite ref="U02091"><he>שתי</he></cite>, ed. <cite ref="B00689"><he>ביצעין</he></cite>, Ms. M. <he>בצעי׳</he>) there were two ponds (reservoirs) in Jerusalem, the upper &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:3">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>בין בִּצְעֵי המים</he> between the dykes (of the Nile).
